title: Line view
asOf: From this tablet, as of {time}: the network is down.

noLine.title: This tablet belongs to no line
noLine.body: The Line view shows one line. Ask the office to set this tablet's line.

calls.title: Calls
calls.unknown: The calls could not be read now. They come back by themselves.

waiting.title: Waiting for you
waiting.unknown: Part of this list could not be read now. It comes back by itself.
waiting.scrap_one: {bundle}: {count} piece of scrap over the limit
waiting.scrap_other: {bundle}: {count} pieces of scrap over the limit

conflict.title: {bundle}: which report stands?
conflict.keep: The report recorded first stands. Why?
conflict.send: The office decides: it corrects the recorded report, the original stays. Why?

reason.SAME_WORK: Both tablets reported the same work
reason.OTHER_STATION: It was done at another station

correction.unread: This request could not be read now. Go back and open it again.

meaning.scrap: You approve this scrap: it goes on to be posted. Your signature is kept with the record.
meaning.block: You decide this time. Your signature is kept with the record.
meaning.conflict: The report recorded first stands and the other is set aside. Your signature is kept with the record.
meaning.correction: You approve this correction: a new record takes over the count and the original stays. Your signature is kept with the record.
meaning.correctionRefused: You refuse this correction: the report stays as it is. Your signature is kept with the record.

done.decided: Done. Nothing else waits for you.
done.next: Done. This is the next one.

reassign.title: Reassign the work of {station}
reassign.none: Nobody can take this work now.

handover.title: Note for the next shift · {shift}
handover.wall: The next shift reads this, and it shows on the line's wall screen. Name nobody.

behalf.lead: Record work for someone who could not scan. Which station?
behalf.offline: No network: the entry is saved on this tablet, and only a bundle this tablet can read can be scanned.
behalf.nobody: Nobody can be named now: their notice must be acknowledged first.
behalf.scanHint: The ticket of the bundle they worked on.
behalf.mark: Marked: entered by the team leader.
behalf.override: This check needs another team leader. They pick the reason, scan their badge and type their PIN.
behalf.badge: Scan the other team leader's badge
behalf.pinMeaning: You let this entry through. Your signature is kept with the record.

camera.error: The camera did not start. Type the code.

held.offline: This needs the network: it signs a record. It waits until the network is back.
held.saved: Your answer is saved on this tablet.
held.noAnswer: Your role does not answer calls.
held.own: This is your own work: another team leader decides it.
held.withOffice: You sent this to the office: it decides there.

note.empty: Pick a topic or write a few words first.

held.record: Read the request first: it is not on this screen yet.

ALREADY_ON_THE_WAY.message: Someone is on the way already.

DECIDED_ALREADY.fix: Go on to the next one.

SELF_DECISION.message: You cannot decide your own work.

BEHALF_SELF.message: You cannot enter your own work on behalf.
BEHALF_SELF.fix: Report it on your own scan.

BEHALF_NO_NOTICE.message: This person has not acknowledged the notice yet.
BEHALF_NO_NOTICE.fix: They acknowledge it at their next sign-in.

OVERRIDE_SELF.message: You cannot sign your own entry.
OVERRIDE_SELF.fix: Ask another team leader to sign.

NOT_QUALIFIED.message: This person has no skill for this work.

NOT_AUTHORISED.message: This person may not use this machine.

STALE.fix: Go back and read it again.

OTHER_KIND.message: This station does not do this kind of work.
OTHER_KIND.fix: Go back and pick a station of the operation's kind of work.

SELF_APPROVAL.message: You took this report or asked this correction.
SELF_APPROVAL.fix: Another team leader or the office decides it.

TARGET_VOIDED.message: The report was undone or corrected since this was asked.
TARGET_VOIDED.fix: Refuse it: the person asks again on the report that stands now.

LESS_THAN_TAKEN.message: The next operation took more pieces than this leaves.
LESS_THAN_TAKEN.fix: Refuse it, or have the next operation corrected first.

MORE_THAN_PASSED.message: This counts more pieces than the operation before passed.
MORE_THAN_PASSED.fix: Refuse it, or have the operation before corrected first.

MORE_THAN_BUNDLE.message: This counts more pieces than the bundle carries.
MORE_THAN_BUNDLE.fix: Refuse it: the person counts again.

PREVIOUS_NOT_REPORTED.message: The operation before this one is not reported yet.
PREVIOUS_NOT_REPORTED.fix: Have it reported first; this request keeps waiting.

NO_COUNT.fix: Refuse it: the person counts again.

SAME_COUNTS.message: The counts and reasons are the same as the report’s.
SAME_COUNTS.fix: Refuse it: there is nothing to change.

UNKNOWN_SCAN.message: The report it names is not on record.

WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN.message: This work order is not in progress any more.

ON_HOLD.message: This bundle or its work order is on hold.
ON_HOLD.fix: It can be decided once quality lifts the hold.
